import os, shutil, sqlite3
os.environ["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"] = "offscreen"
import vocapp
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

tmp = "/tmp/vocab_cycle.db"
shutil.copy\("vocabulary.db", tmp\)
vocapp.DB_FILE = tmp
vocapp.init_db\(\)
app = QApplication\([]\)
w = vocapp.VocabApp\(\)
w.show\(\)

def count\(name\):
    c = sqlite3.connect\(tmp\)
    n = c.execute\("SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM words WHERE english=?", \(name,\)\).fetchone\(\)[0]
    c.close\(\)
    return n

def click_save\(\):
    QTest.mouseClick\(w.save_button, Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton\)
    QTest.qWait\(50\)

# 1. save fresh
w.ent_eng.setText\("wordA"\); w.ent_mm.setText\("mmA"\)
click_save\(\)
print\("1 save ->", w.save_button.text\(\), "count:", count\("wordA"\), "| status:", w.status_label.text\(\)\)

# 2. edit first row matching wordA
w.ent_search.setText\("wordA"\); QTest.qWait\(20\)
item = w.tree.topLevelItem\(0\)
w.tree.clearSelection\(\); item.setSelected\(True\)
w.edit_word\(\)
print\("2 edit -> button:", w.save_button.text\(\), "cancel enabled:", w.cancel_button.isEnabled\(\)\)
w.ent_eng.setText\("wordA2"\)
click_save\(\)
print\("2 update -> count wordA:", count\("wordA"\), "wordA2:", count\("wordA2"\), "| button:", w.save_button.text\(\), "| status:", w.status_label.text\(\)\)

# 3. save again after update
w.ent_eng.setText\("wordB"\); w.ent_mm.setText\("mmB"\)
click_save\(\)
print\("3 save after update -> count wordB:", count\("wordB"\), "| button:", w.save_button.text\(\), "| status:", w.status_label.text\(\)\)

# 4. edit then cancel, then save
w.ent_search.clear\(\); QTest.qWait\(20\)
item = w.tree.topLevelItem\(0\)
w.tree.clearSelection\(\); item.setSelected\(True\)
w.edit_word\(\)
w.cancel_edit\(\)
print\("4 after cancel -> button:", w.save_button.text\(\), "| status:", w.status_label.text\(\)\)
w.ent_eng.setText\("wordC"\); w.ent_mm.setText\("mmC"\)
click_save\(\)
print\("4 save after cancel -> count wordC:", count\("wordC"\), "| status:", w.status_label.text\(\)\)
EOF
